question: LCM and HCF of two numbers are 90 and 15, respectively. If the sum of the two numbers is 75, then find the greater number.
solution:
**Given:**

LCM and HCF of two numbers are 90 and 15, respectively.

The sum of the two numbers is 75

**Concept used:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

**Calculation:**

Let the two numbers be a and b

So,

a + b = 75 ----(i)

⇒ (a + b)² = 5625

⇒ a² + b2 + 2ab = 5625

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2 × 90 × 15 = 5625

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2700 = 5625

⇒ a2 + b2 = 5625 - 2700

⇒ a2 + b2 = 2925

Now,

a2 + b2 - 2ab = (a - b)²

⇒ 2925 - 2700 = (a - b)2

⇒ 225 = (a - b)2

⇒ 15² = (a - b)2

⇒ 15 = (a - b) ----(ii)

Now,

From eq (i) and (ii) we can say

a = 45 and b = 30

**∴ The greater number is 45.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** LCM × HCF = Product of two numbers

 Let one number be x

Other number = (75 - x)

 Then,

 ⇒ 90 × 15 = x(75 - x)

 ⇒ 1350 = 75x - x2

 ⇒ x2 - 75x + 1350=0

 ⇒ x2- 45x - 30x + 1350=0

 ⇒ x = 45, 30

 ∴ Greater number = 45
